provenance.pubchem_citation: Kim S, Chen J, Cheng T, et al. PubChem 2025 update. Nucleic Acids Res. 2025;53(D1):D1516-D1525. doi:10.1093/nar/gkae1059
provenance.notes: Easy-tier central metabolite + minimal charged ion (08-PROPOSALS.md Set 2, APPROVED 2026-09-26): citric acid + acetate anion CID 175 (formal charge -1). Per-record citation per U1: 'PubChem Identifier: CID <CID>; URL: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/<CID>'. Complex reference metadata: CC0 1.0 (wwPDB). AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human PHYSIOLOGICAL-PROTONATION decision '2 go R1-R8', 08.1-08 protonation audit row 3, directive: 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally' — the decision SUPERSEDES Decision 5's 'deprotonated citrate sourcing REJECTED for v1' which had only the 2D ChEBI route; the audit found the clean PubChem 3D route): citric acid CID 311 neutral free acid -> citrate(3-) CID 31348 (C6H5O7^3-, 90.9% at pH 7.4; pKa1 3.13 / pKa2 4.76 / pKa3 6.39-6.40 Wikipedia chembox citing Sigma/Silva et al. Dalton Trans 2009). The set's salt-bridge capability was acetate-only; citrate now ALSO a salt-bridge carrier (second '-' carrier, additive).

Citrate(3-), PubChem CID 31348 (C6H5O7^3-, 13 heavy, Charge -3 as recorded - 3x M CHG -1, central alcohol OH retained). Complex: 1CTS citrate synthase with citric acid (the more classic reference; CIT 'CITRIC ACID' confirmed in the RCSB nonpolymer inventory via the data API, 2026-10-04). Carries salt_bridge STRONG (three carboxylates, all deprotonated) - citrate is now the set's SECOND '-' salt-bridge carrier beside acetate, h_bond rich (alcohol OH donor; all carboxylate O acceptors), hydrophobic. AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human decision '2 go R1-R8', audit row 3/R1 - the human's original audit trigger 'citrate supposed to be deprotonated under physiological pH, but currently fully protonated' CONFIRMED, directive 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally'): was CID 311 neutral free acid (Charge 0 as recorded per Decision 5 - the 'deprotonated citrate sourcing REJECTED for v1' verdict, superseded now that a clean PubChem 3D route exists; 21 atoms {1:17,2:3}); swapped to citrate(3-) CID 31348 (citrate3- 90.9% / H-citrate2- 9.1% at pH 7.4; pKa1 3.13, pKa2 4.76, pKa3 6.39-6.40 Wikipedia chembox citing Sigma/Silva et al. Dalton Trans 2009; zero-ionic-strength values 3.128/4.761/6.396; PubChem record itself carries only the Serjeant 1979 pKa 2.79 - transparently weaker single annotation, recorded in audit section 5/6). The H-citrate(2-) minority CID 24802 was recorded but NOT chosen. Neutral CID 311 record stays in git history. AMENDED 2026-10-04 (human directive, 08.1-08 checkpoint finding 4): reference complex 8FUY -> 1CTS citrate synthase with citric acid (the more classic reference). Verified live 2026-10-04: CIT ligand 'CITRIC ACID' confirmed in the RCSB nonpolymer inventory (data API nonpolymer entity 2); entry DOI resolves (302 to wwpdb); paper DOI https://doi.org/10.1016/0022-2836(82)90452-1 resolves (302 Elsevier linkhub) and its CrossRef title 'Crystallographic refinement and atomic models of two different forms of citrate synthase at 2.7 and 1.7 A resolution' (Remington, Wiegand, Huber, JMB 1982) matches the RCSB primary citation exactly - the paper DOI is no longer an honest absence. The prior 8FUY record (C.fasciculata G6PDH; paper DOI none recorded) stays in git history.

Acetate anion, PubChem CID 175 (C2H3O2-, 4 heavy, Charge -1 as recorded - the deprotonated anion CHOSEN over acetic acid deliberately: it is the salt-bridge carrier; carboxylate charge-group typing requires the recorded charge). Complex: 5YS8 succinate-acetate permease (ACT in inventory; paper DOI resolves 200). Carries salt_bridge (carboxylate -1 charged group), h_bond (carboxylate O acceptors), hydrophobic (methyl). FILE is the set-scoped demo-easy-2-acetate.sdf; the dev set's legacy ligands/acetate.sdf is a different script-built file and stays untouched.
